title: Challenges
notes: Options on the title: your name, and a switch for whether anyone can challenge you.
Competing is by invitation now. Challenge someone on a leaderboard: you race their ghost at once, they accept on their title, and then it is mutual, one challenge at a time.
Shade only flies between the two of you. Beat the person you compete with and the summit card lets you throw it; they see it on that sky and can race you back.
